description: Rotate vault token on prod without quorum — quorum required

playbook.content:
- name: Rotate vault token
  hosts: production
  become: yes
  tasks:
    - ansible.builtin.include_vars:
        file: new_vault_token.yml
    - ansible.builtin.template:
        src: vault_config.j2
        dest: /etc/vault/config.hcl

tier_rationale: Vault token rotation on production tier1 — quorum required
